newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Silver Grant, Beijing Wangfujing in JV.
newsitem.headline: Silver Grant, Beijing Wangfujing in JV.

text.p: Silver Grant International Industries Ltd said unit Silver Grant International Department Store Ltd and Beijing Wangfujing Department Store (Group) Co Ltd have agreed to set up a 50-50 joint venture.
The total investment and registered capital of Beijing Wang Fu Jing Retail Management Co Ltd will be US$29.8 million.
The joint venture agreement is subject to official approval.
Silver Grant said the joint venture company will have operations in major cities in China such as Beijing, Shanghai, Chengdu, Guangzhou and Wuhan.
The company will act as a management company for commercial enterprises, which may include the operation of department stores and shopping malls.
The company said it expected the joint venture to generate steady cash flow and income and diversify its investment portfolio in China.
Silver Grant shares were up HK$0.05 at HK$2.55 in Friday morning trade.
